title: A layout the template does not have

buildSteps.label: A layout
buildSteps.description: A layout is a React component that is given a slide's fields. The deck's layouts folder registers it under the name that slides use.

buildSteps.label: What it can draw
buildSteps.description: Anything a browser can: a canvas, SVG, a chart, and WebGL through three.js, which is already installed.

buildSteps.label: The rules
buildSteps.description: The stage is 1280 by 720 and is scaled, never reflowed. A layout stops what it starts when the slide is left, and shows one still frame when the deck is captured.

buildSteps.label: So you ask
buildSteps.description: Say what the slide shows and what each key press changes. The agent writes the component, registers it, adds the slide, and captures it to look at its own work.
